Name: (CP or AT) PuppyCat for Cats
Author: bobacup
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Bnp0pk1Z/puppycat.png[/img][/center]
[color=#f4cccc][center]PuppyCat is a character from the 'Bee and PuppyCat' show created by Natasha Allegri!
This is fan art.

[b]Please do not edit / redistribute / claim these sprites as your own!
[/b]
The Content Patcher version for Stardew Valley 1.6 will add PuppyCat as an additional cat choice![/center][/color]
[line]
[color=#e06666][size=6][b][u]୨୧  Installation & Use  ୨୧
[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]For Content Patcher[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b][b][color=#ea9999]To Install:[/color][/b][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for [b]1.6 [/b]is installed.
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Download the Content Patcher version .zip from the Files tab on this mod page.
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Extract the .zip and place the [CP] PuppyCat folder into your …\ Stardew Valley \ Mods folder
[b]
[b][color=#ea9999]To Use:[/color][/b][/b]
You can select PuppyCat as your starter pet on a new save OR purchase the pet license at Marnie's Ranch when the requirements are met.[/spoiler]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]For Alternative Textures[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b][color=#ea9999]To Install:[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] is installed.
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Download the Alternative Textures version .zip from the Files tab on this mod page.
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Extract the .zip and place the [AT] PuppyCat folder into your …\ Stardew Valley \ Mods folder
[b][color=#ea9999]
To Use:[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ea9999]1.[/color][/b] Purchase the Scissors (a tool added by Alternative Textures) at Robin's Carpenter's Shop
[b][color=#ea9999]2.[/color][/b] Interact with the cat you'd like to change with the Scissors selected on your hotbar
[b][color=#ea9999]3.[/color][/b] Choose the PuppyCat option on the menu that appears[/spoiler]

[b][color=#ea9999][u]Known Issues[/u][/color][/b]
[spoiler]- Hats placed on PuppyCat will not be aligned correctly.[/spoiler]
